agent_types.DecisionMakerAgent: Responsible for analyzing data from various sources and making strategic decisions to guide the system towards its goals.
agent_types.CommunicationAgent: Handles interactions between agents, ensuring proper data exchange and coordination within the system.
agent_types.EnvironmentMonitorAgent: Observes and reports on the external environment, providing relevant updates to other agents to adjust their strategies accordingly.
agent_types.ResourceManagerAgent: Optimizes resource allocation and usage across the system, ensuring efficient operation and minimizing waste.
agent_types.LearningAgent: Continually improves its performance by analyzing outcomes and adapting to new information or changes in the environment.
